summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long FLEX Daily ETF (FLEL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Flex Ltd (NASDAQ: FLEX) stock, less fees and expenses. FLEX operates as a manufacturing services company FLEL was launched on Aug 19, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.
